catches: You must enter promo code STDIG9 at account opening — accounts opened without the promo code do not qualify.
Offer ends September 30, 2026; opening after that date earns nothing.

Two qualifying direct deposits of at least $500 each must post within 90 calendar days of opening; qualifying direct deposits are recurring electronic payroll, pension, or Social Security deposits only — person-to-person, S&T account transfers, and internet payment-service transfers do not qualify.
The checking account must remain open with a balance greater than $0 on January 8, 2027 and never be overdrawn — one overdraft kills the bonus.
New personal checking customers only: anyone who held or closed an S&T personal checking or savings account in the last 12 months is not eligible.
Only Four Star Banking, Preferred Banking, Select Banking accounts can be opened online; other eligible accounts require a branch visit or call to 800.325.2265.
Bonus is reportable for tax purposes.
One account-related gift incentive per person per rolling 12-month period.

steps: Go to the official S&T Bank offer page https://www.stbank.com/specials/paoc-q3-2026/ and confirm the offer is still showing before you apply (it ends September 30, 2026).

Open a new eligible personal checking account (Four Star, Preferred, or Select Banking; excludes Smart Start Banking and Easy Banking) online or in a branch by September 30, 2026, entering promo code STDIG9 at account opening.
Note your account opening date — your 90-day direct-deposit window runs from that date.

Route at least two separate qualifying direct deposits of $500 or more each to the new account within 90 days — recurring payroll, pension, or Social Security deposits only; Zelle, Venmo, and transfers from other banks do not count.
Keep the account open, never overdrawn, with a balance greater than $0 through January 8, 2027.
The $300 incentive is deposited into your account on January 14, 2027 if all requirements are met.
